dct_creator_sm: Meyer, David (University of Toronto). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0979-118X
dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains test results for water and soil quality from Delhi, India. Tests were done in order to determine the baseline prevalence of contamination in piped water and in soil nearby water distribution pipes. 

Samples were gathered and processed by FARELABS Pvt. Ltd.
dct_title_s: Baseline Data Supporting:  Effects of hydraulically disconnecting consumer pumps in an intermittent water supply
